native_minibatch.grpo_definition: Read saved diagnostic_grpo_advantages, computed before original dispatch by the official global-UID GRPO owner; not recomputed by this analyzer.

original_token_id_mass.scope: Global pooled saved actor-action token occurrences, grouped by original integer responses ID; no decoding, re-encoding or token-function inference.
original_token_id_mass.weighting_limit: Pooled mass/frequency is descriptive and is not the native PPO loss weighting: the original actor averages each B4 over its own loss_mask token count, then accumulates eight B4 losses with /8.
original_token_id_mass.selection: Union of each method's top20 positive/negative finite absolute mass IDs, plus the three explicitly requested existing IDs.
original_token_id_mass.requested_id_meaning: ID categories only; this statistic does not assign a function to these IDs.
original_token_id_mass.nonfinite_scope: Nonfinite advantages are counted by ID and excluded from mass statistics; no replacement advantage is supplied to a loss.
original_token_id_mass.zero_total_mass_coverage: null when the corresponding observed total mass is zero; no epsilon or pass threshold is introduced.

saved_dt_q_action_tokens.definition: Saved dt_q_estimates on original actor policy-token positions; zero also includes any owner-unmapped positions, not a reconstructed event label.

limits: Global pooled token masses are descriptive; the native loss averages each B4 by its own original mask count and accumulates eight B4 losses with /8.
This snapshot's training row outcome is distinct from each source response's complete G_t; saved Q zero can also include unmapped positions.
ID statistics assign no token function and are not a gradient, oracle, causal conclusion or numerical gate.
No gradient result is read or reconstructed by this batch-only invocation.
